correctness.rationale: Let q=a^2 and stationary Y_j=aY_{j-1}+xi_j with E xi^2=2Dm and cum4(xi)=12D^2 v. Bilateral moving average gives EY^2=2Dm/(1-q), cum4(Y)=12D²v/(1-q²). Conditional quadratic regression yields Cov(Y_j²,Y_{j+h}²)=q^h Var(Y²); exact geometric covariance summation gives the claimed finite-n work variance and long-run CLT variance. A square-integrable martingale difference decomposition gives the fixed-a CLT. Under n(1-q)->ell>0, normalized stationary AR1 interpolation converges to dZ=-Z/2 dt+dB with stationary normal start; normalized reward is a Riemann integral of Z². Wick covariance integral proves variance 4(ell-1+exp(-ell))/ell² and non-Gaussianity. Independent symbolic algebra checked each variance identity and OU covariance integral. Conditions exclude a=1, infinite second moments and physical-time work counts.

originality.rationale: Olsen and Gupta (2024) introduced the partial-reset harmonic-work model and derived a-independent mean cost, one-time stationary moments and numerical work plots, while explicitly proposing work fluctuations as a future problem. The exact finite-reset correlated-work variance and path-level joint weak-reset crossover are not in its inspected results. Complete resetting work-fluctuation papers use iid renewal blocks; continuous-time refractory/erasure models have different reset protocols. The AR(1) covariance and OU invariance machinery themselves are classical, not new.
residual_risks: General dependent additive-functional / AR1 stochastic thermodynamics may contain an equivalent specialized evaluated formula.
Stationary event-indexed counting and finite Var(T) essential; no full work density or laboratory-time theorem.

value.rationale: A physically meaningful work-reliability quantity is quantified beyond the previously established mean-only law. The exact variance separates reset persistence from exploration-time randomness, shows singular loss of self-averaging as a->1, and identifies a non-Gaussian critical distribution despite Gaussian one-time position limits.

final_claim: For stationary event-indexed harmonic partial resetting with iid positive exploration times of finite second moment and a<1, the exact finite-reset work variance, fixed-a CLT and universal weak-reset integrated-stationary-OU-square limit hold.
limitations: Finite second moment of iid exploration durations, stationary endpoint chain; exactly n completed contractions.
No result for a=1, fixed elapsed physical time, return-phase dynamics, infinite-variance duration laws or full large-deviation rate.
